## Rule (derived 2026-07-07, worker batch 53)

Per-column gravity on 5×5 grids, colors {0,1,5} only. Two column archetypes: **type-a** `bg,bg,1,5,5`
→ `bg,bg,bg,5,1` (the `1` falls to the base row, swapping with the base 5); **type-b** `bg,bg,bg,bg,5`
→ unchanged. NOT a whole-grid identity/transpose/flip/rotate (the prompt's "perfect-25 zero-cost ≤1"
rumor is disproven by the data).

## LIVE graph = cost 40 (NOT the stale 1407 below)

Live bar **40** (manifest, Aditya, sha `e4316b…`). LIVE is a single depthwise **Conv**, group=10,
weight `(10,1,4,1)`=40 params, 0 intermediates. ch1 `[0,1,0,0]` (shift down 2); ch5 `[0,0,-1,1]`
(`in5[i]−in5[i−1]`); ch0 `[-1,1,0,1]` (bg extension); other 7 channels zero-kernels. The 1407-cost
Slice/Concat/Pad graph in the AUTO-DIAG / Spread blocks below is a superseded extract — ignore it.

## FLOOR PROOF — WALL at cost 40 (batch 53)

Gate decodes **per-channel `(out>0)`**, not argmax (`ng_harness/session.py:run_raw`). ch0 must be
`>0` exactly at output-bg cells incl. the vacated cell. `score_v2` counts params per element ⇒
cost = 10·K for weight `(10,1,K,1)`. A win needs a correct kernel at K≤3, but separating type-a
from type-b forces taps at offsets `{0,−2,−3}` (non-uniform) ⇒ contiguous **K=4** = 40 params.
Brute-force (weights −2..2, all pads/dilations) finds NO K=2/K=3 solution; K=4 has 16.
Full argument + exact gate lines: `task073/hard_records/depthwise_conv_kernel_floor.md`.

## Cost analysis

Memory=1340B from intermediates: fall_mask[20], not_fall[20], channel0[100], channel1[100], channel5[100], small_output[1000]. Params=71 elements in initializers. Input/output [1,10,30,30] are excluded from the scoring function (neurogolf_utils.calculate_memory skips tensors named 'input'/'output'). The model already processes at 5×5 scale internally; the only 30×30 tensors are the excluded input/output.

## Don't-do log

- **crop-to-5x5** (2026-05-19): FAILED — costs MORE. The advisory's -35000 estimate is wrong. The scoring function (`calculate_memory`) explicitly skips tensors named 'input' and 'output', so the [1,10,30,30] input/output contribute nothing to the score. Adding a crop Slice creates a NEW intermediate 'input_cropped' [1,10,5,5] = 1000B that IS counted, increasing cost from 1411 to 2423. This applies to all similar tasks (Group V) that already have Slice-upfront + Pad-at-end structure. The advisory tool incorrectly counted the graph input as a [30,30] intermediate.
